kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتطف (form VIII)
# نَعْتَطِفُ (naʕtaṭifu) /naʕ.ta.tˤi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# نُعْتَطَفُ (nuʕtaṭafu) /nuʕ.ta.tˤa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# نَعْتَطِفَ (naʕtaṭifa) /naʕ.ta.tˤi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# نُعْتَطَفَ (nuʕtaṭafa) /nuʕ.ta.tˤa.f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
